title: Independent fixed-charge radial finite-volume minimization
scope: Local classical scalar energy minimization at the existing Candidate 1 couplings; implementation cross-check, not independent external validation or proof of a global minimizer.
gradient_energy: 0.5*sum_faces(4*pi*r_face^2/h)*(delta F^2+delta S^2); origin has zero area; outer Dirichlet F=0,S=1 is a half-cell away and uses coefficient 4*pi*L^2/(h/2).
charge_elimination: I=sum_i V_i F_i^2; E_Q=Qbar^2/(2I)+E_gradient+sum_i V_i Ubar_i; Omega=Qbar/I

starts.name: bvp_shape
starts.formula: c=(Qbar/Qstar)^(1/3); F_i=F_BVP(r_i/c), S_i=S_BVP(r_i/c); interpolate the existing target BVP profile, use vacuum outside its range. No BVP solve is called.

optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize L-BFGS-B with an independently implemented objective and analytic gradients
run_order: charge fractions in listed order; N in listed order; starts in listed order
preflight: Check analytic objective gradients against central finite differences in four deterministic random directions on N=32,L=8 with strictly interior test fields; two step sizes 1e-5 and 3e-6. Abort physical optimization if relative discrepancy exceeds 1e-5 in both steps for any direction.
outputs: independent_results.json, independent_execution.jsonl, independent_profiles.npz, independent_results.csv, independent_notes.md; retain optimizer stop flags, convergence failures and budget-skipped runs.
interpretation: Compare energies and Omega at matched charge against the stationary branch and compare N=800 versus N=1600. Multiple starts and numerical agreement support local implementation consistency only. Finite domain fixed at L40: no claim of a new domain refinement or global minimization.
